newsitem.title: UK: FedEx to start non-stop direct Osaka/Memphis flight.
newsitem.headline: FedEx to start non-stop direct Osaka/Memphis flight.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said it will start operating a daily direct non-stop MD-11 flight between Osaka and Memphis on September one giving a next day delivery to most North American cities from most Asian markets.
The new route flight will fly from Singapore via Osaka's Kansai International Airport to Fedex's main Americas hub at Memphis replacing a daily Osaka/Memphis servis with a touchdown at Anchorage.

By dropping the Alaska stop, Fedex said the Asian departure time can be delayed to allow a later cut-off time in the Osaka area whilst also guaranteeing next day delivery in the U.S.. Fedex said the 12 hour non-stop flight to Memphis will halve transit times across the Pacific to 24 from 48 hours.
